column32: Validates row-count, duplicate and orphan checks on every org chart / HRIS import.

column4: Require a documented justification for every score/state change recorded across Modules 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12 and 14.
column17: Change Log entries with justification text
column32: Platform-wide toggle (mandatory by default) blocking a score/state save without a logged justification.

column4: Ensure every detected Knowledge/Ability-vs-Bridges divergence is routed to a Change Manager for review within SLA.
column32: Confirms RULE-008 detections generate ALT-001 and reach a Change Manager within the SLA breach threshold.

column4: Verify the 60/90-day regression audit cadence executes for every cohort and produces a reviewable result.
column17: Audit run log + regression flag history
column32: Ensures the checkpoint audit fires on schedule and that any regression flag reaches ACT-006.

column4: Guarantee no Assistive/Augmented AI output is published, distributed or acted upon without an explicit human confirmation.
column32: Blocks any AI Use Case Library output from taking effect until a human accepts, edits, or rejects it; logs the outcome.

column4: Ensure only a Super Admin can edit the runtime-configurable Permission Matrix and every access check reads from it consistently.
column32: Confirms every page-access, write-button and delete-control check in the app reads from the same live Permission Matrix grid.

column4: Ensure permissions are always the product of role × scope (Group/Organization/Project), never a single global role.
column32: Confirms a role assigned in one Project never grants visibility into a different Project's data.

column2: MFA / SSO Enforcement for Administrative Roles
column4: Require multi-factor authentication or enterprise SSO for Super Admin, Group Admin and Organization Admin accounts.
column23: journi Functional Spec §3.3 Account Creation & Security Best Practices
column32: Verifies MFA/SSO is enforced on first login for every administrative-scope account.

column4: Ensure self-service employee sign-up is restricted to verified corporate domains and requires Admin approval before activation.
column32: Confirms only domain-verified sign-ups reach a pending Employee role, and only Admin-approved accounts activate.

column4: Ensure deleting a Group, Organization, Main Project or CM Project cascades correctly and un-links (rather than deletes) optional linkages.
column32: Verifies deleting an Organization removes dependent records while deleting a Main Project only un-links (not deletes) linked CM Projects.

column4: Ensure every Phase Gate Go/Go-with-Conditions/No-Go decision names exactly one Accountable role, never 'the system.'
column32: Blocks a Phase Gate save that lacks exactly one named Accountable role.

column2: AI Use Case Activation Scope Enforcement
column4: Ensure AI Use Case activation/deactivation respects the Group/Organization/Project override hierarchy in the Permission Matrix.
column32: Confirms a project-level AI override cannot occur unless the Organization Admin has explicitly delegated that control.

column4: Ensure Sponsors and Executive Viewers see only aggregated, de-identified readiness data — never individual-level ADKAR or sentiment.
column23: journi Functional Spec §3.3 Data-visibility rules by default
column32: Confirms individual ADKAR scores and sentiment never surface to a Sponsor/Executive Viewer role, only aggregated views.

column4: Ensure applying a Phase Template to a Project never overwrites tasks a Change Manager has already added or edited.
column23: journi Functional Spec §Module 18 Phase Template Library
column32: Verifies a template-seeded WBS never silently overwrites a Change Manager's manual edits.

column4: Ensure any Real LLM Provider API key entered in Module 17 is stored only in the signed-in user's browser local storage, isolated from application data.
column23: journi Functional Spec §Module 17 Real LLM Provider Connection
column32: Confirms the provider API key is never bundled into seed data or transmitted to a journi backend.

column23: journi Functional Spec §Module 17 Real LLM Provider Connection
